definition: A semantic and predictive AI architecture that continuously ingests time-ordered evidence, builds a provenance-aware semantic memory, learns from resolved outcomes, and emits numerical forecasts or calibrated probabilities for preregistered future targets.
canonical_equations: SEMANTIC_AI = OBSERVE + REPRESENT + LINK + RETRIEVE + EXPLAIN_PROVENANCE
JANUS_SPI = SEMANTIC_MEMORY + ONLINE_LEARNING + FORECAST_LEDGER + ADVERSARIAL_VERIFICATION + HABITAT_CONTINUITY

origin_prime_learning_law.cycle: ORIGIN_n -> OBSERVE/TRAIN_n -> FROZEN_FORECAST_n -> OUTCOME_n -> VERIFIED_RETURN_n -> ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1)
rules: verified experience may initialize the next generation
old predictions never become new labels without current verification
model updates occur only after the forecast target resolves

real_time_semantics.meaning: event-driven or polling ingestion at runtime; not a claim that GitHub itself trains a model continuously while no runner is active

ONLINE.anti_leakage: future outcome must not enter feature extraction before resolution

BATCH.use: periodic clean retraining from immutable ledger

CONTINUAL.use: ORIGIN_PRIME generations with forgetting checks and replayable checkpoints

FOUNDATION_MODEL_ASSISTANCE.authority: proposal/semantic extraction only unless independently verified

connection_state.reason: A repository can contain the runtime and configuration but continuous learning requires an executing local/NAS/cloud runner.

black_hole_training_domain.name: JANUS HORIZON
black_hole_training_domain.purpose: first flagship scientific training domain for the predictive core
black_hole_training_domain.narrative_identity: Hawkar / Son of Osiris / Bird-Headed Man

examples: probability CI fails on next change
probability an open gate remains blocked by next checkpoint
probability a preregistered candidate beats baseline

maturity_ladder.name: LOCAL_CORE
maturity_ladder.criterion: semantic ingest/search + online learning primitives + persistent ledger

maturity_ladder.name: CONSTELLATION_READ
maturity_ladder.criterion: read-only ingestion from frozen main-repository list

maturity_ladder.name: HABITAT_CONTINUITY
maturity_ladder.criterion: Habitat events enter ledger without gaining command authority

maturity_ladder.name: FORECAST_LEDGER
maturity_ladder.criterion: predictions frozen before outcomes and scored after resolution

maturity_ladder.name: CALIBRATED_REAL_TIME
maturity_ladder.criterion: rolling calibration and drift metrics over real resolved forecasts

maturity_ladder.name: CROSS_DOMAIN_TRANSFER
maturity_ladder.criterion: transfer benefit demonstrated on withheld domains without protected-baseline degradation

maturity_ladder.name: JANUS_HORIZON
maturity_ladder.criterion: black-hole domain pipeline passes blind observational and negative-control gates

success_definition: JANUS-SPI is successful when it improves prediction and semantic retrieval across multiple environments while preserving provenance, calibration, uncertainty, domain-specific truth conditions, negative results and human/external authority boundaries.
failure_definition: The system is considered failed or invalid for a claim if it leaks future labels, rewrites targets after seeing outcomes, treats semantic resemblance as causation, hides failed forecasts, becomes overconfident under domain shift, or uses narrative identity as evidence.
canonical_cycle: OBSERVE -> SEMANTIC_LINK -> DEFINE_FUTURE_TARGET -> FREEZE -> PREDICT -> WAIT_FOR_CAUSAL_OUTCOME -> SCORE -> ATTACK -> LEARN -> VERIFIED_RETURN_OR_REJECT -> ORIGIN_PRIME
short_form_ru: JANUS-SPI должен не угадывать будущее, а учиться делать проверяемые вероятностные прогнозы из прошлого и настоящего, хранить каждую ошибку и становиться лучше только после того, как будущее реально стало прошлым.
